name: SearXNG Search
description: Searches through a SearXNG instance you run. No key, no limits but your own. The instance must allow JSON and web apps.

url.title: Your SearXNG address
url.description: Like https://search.example.com. In the instance's settings.yml, put json under search: formats:, and have its web server send Access-Control-Allow-Origin for annai's address. Plain http works only for localhost.
